Vendored browser dependencies, loaded only when a traveller exports a PDF.
No external scripts, fonts or images are requested by the PDF exporter.

pdf-lib 1.17.1: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT)
@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT)
Fonts and logo use the existing local Ostrovok assets; see ../README.txt.
